name: SWIR XBookmark
title: 10.29 BETA — SYMBOL SAFE NICKS
nick_policy: Nickname punctuation is identity data. Internal or terminal ':' and other valid symbols are never stripped from protocol/user identity. Only one final native CZATeria display delimiter ':' is removed while parsing a message-login DOM label.
friends_policy: 10.29 preserves exact nickname punctuation through local friend storage, UserData resolution, outgoing 8/4 username, incoming ACK identity, 159 snapshot keys and rooms panel lookup.
legacy_guard_policy: The symbol-safe Friends core retains the WebSocket friend-packet ownership gate so legacy 9.7/10.6 timers cannot race the 10.29 8/4 and 85 flow.
route_policy: 10.29 retains the 10.28 per-socket ACK Route Guard behavior.
snapshot_policy: 10.29 uses the 10.25-style fresh per-connection 159 merge with 15s TTL, but exact nickname punctuation is preserved.
rooms_policy: Friends panel uses simple labels only and preserves the exact nickname, including ':' and other symbols.
mix_policy: Confirmed 10.19 Color-aligned MIX 8/8 module is loaded unchanged.
honour_policy: Honour Probe remains rejected and is not loaded.
launcher_policy: Stable and Beta remain separate; 10.29 is current beta and 10.28 is immediate rollback.
